data.long_meaning: Derived from the Irish word ‘cú’ meaning hound or warrior and ‘lan’ meaning lover or little one. In Irish mythology, Cúchulainn is a legendary hero, a powerful warrior and hunter. The name Cullan carries the meaning “Strong warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Cullan usually hope their child will grow to embody strong warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
